description: This Java interface defines a registry for JSON parsable objects, capable of returning supported types and parsing from JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonParsableRegistry
classes.description: An interface for a registry that manages JSON parsable objects and can parse them from JSON, supporting retrieval of supported types.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns a set of supported types (such as command, response, event, error).

search-terms: Java interface for JSON parsable registry
